method: Only frozen independent slots/forward gold, approved cold plan and static public boundary order; author read no new SUT output and runs no SUT. No legacy39/helper/production edits. Readers receive canonical forged data bytes, all data-based report hirDigest values match the supplied HIR, all six semantic fixed variants use exact v4 per-row/publication rehash. Accessors are deliberately non-JSON and never canonicalized; they retain clean original wire bytes and reject before any getter read.
